metric_basis: R11 2026-10-15: three-state gold under survey svyglm variance (analysis_plan §6 primary standard); coverage = P(tested | rule exists, judgeable, non-negative-control) — the pre-R11 formula divided by ALL testable pairs and became meaningless once the exposure×outcome matrix was expanded

precision_rule.note: point estimates with CP CIs: NHANES [0.541, 1.0] / KNHANES [0.478, 1.0] (width reflects small informative n)

precision_binary_uninf_as_fp.note: R11: the conservative reading (uninformative counted as a failed prediction). Report BOTH this and precision_rule; the old deliverables showed only the favourable denominator.

matrix.note: full exposure×outcome matrix, exploratory family (separate from rule metrics)
